images.filename: Horse memorial, cape road, port elizabeth, south africa.jpg
images.caption: The Horse Memorial (Cape Road, Port Elizabeth, South Africa) bears the words: "greatness of a nation consists not so much in the number of its people or the extent of its territory as in the extent and justice of its compassion"  "erected by public subscription in recognition of the services of the gallant animals which perished in the anglo boer war 1899-1902"
